blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Saying it does not intend to “silence” criticisms from the Mangyan-Iraya community, developer Pieceland Corporation insists it has the legal right over a 302,944 square meter property in Barangay Poblacion at Abra de Ilog town in Occidental Mindoro which an indigenous tribal organization claims as part of its ancestral domain. In a letter sent to the Inquirer on Thursday (Sept. 24), Angelo Decena, the firm’s Vice President for Administration and Corporate Secretary, also reacted to claims aired online by the Samahan ng Katutubong Mangyan-Iraya sa Sitio Mangyan that called for the dismissal of what had described […]...
